column2: [intro]
I have hats with glitter bright,
Tiny trinkets, pure delight.
Stuffed toys by the thousand strong,
Everything to keep me going on.
My collection, such a craze,
I gather things in countless ways.
Objects for every kind of taste,
It’s my passion, not a waste.
I have keys and spinning tops,
Glasses shaped like hippie props.
Toys that twirl and spin around,
Everything that makes life sound.
My collection, it’s my drive,
A joyful mess, it’s so alive.
Curious things that make me smile,
My world, a playful, vibrant style.
[solo]
My collection, such a craze,
I gather things in countless ways.
Objects for every kind of taste,
It’s my passion, not a waste.
[outro]
